purpose: Implement task dependency resolution with cycle detection and completion state evaluation
constraints: deterministic alphabetical sort on output slices

tasks.title: Implement ResolveExecutableTasks
tasks.context: Tasks cannot execute until all prerequisite conditions are met; cycles must be caught before scheduling.
tasks.why: Prevent deadlocks and scheduling stalled tasks.

references.excerpt: func ResolveExecutableTasks(tasks []TaskNode, completed map[string]bool) (executable []string, blocked []string, err error)

decisions.chosen: Depth-first search with visited/recStack for cycle detection

steps.action: Build adjacency map and validate no cycles using DFS
steps.expected: Cycles detected and rejected with CYCLE_DETECTED

steps.action: Filter uncompleted tasks. If all DependsOn in completed, append to executable; else blocked
steps.expected: Correct partitioning into executable and blocked
steps.on_failure: Verify map lookup for completed state

interfaces: func ResolveExecutableTasks(tasks []TaskNode, completed map[string]bool) (executable []string, blocked []string, err error)
constraints: Dependency cycle must return error containing CYCLE_DETECTED

examples.explanation: B is executable because A is completed

stop_conditions: Cycle error must halt resolution immediately

acceptance.requirement: Tasks with all satisfied dependencies are classified as executable
acceptance.given: Task list and map of completed prerequisites
acceptance.expected: Executable tasks returned in sorted order

acceptance.requirement: Tasks with unmet prerequisites are classified as blocked
